strings.supportBody: Even if it feels as though nobody understands, there are people who want to listen. To find mental-health support in your area, open a browser and search for “mental health helpline” or “crisis support number” followed by your country or city. Check that the number belongs to a trusted local service. You can simply say: “I’m having a hard time.”
strings.emergencyBody: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services. Do not wait to finish the questionnaire.
strings.guideBody: Open the downloaded HTML file in a browser; it will not work in preview mode. A single choice is saved in the open questionnaire; for multiple choices or text, press “Save & Next”. Save progress to a file before taking a break. You can keep the file on your phone or computer. It is not encrypted, so share it only with people you trust or healthcare professionals. Do not post it on social media or anywhere public. You decide what to discuss with a professional. For an accuracy review, skip questions that seem fine; flag questions that seem incorrect or unclear and choose a reason. At the end, select “Generate report” to preview and save the clinician PDF. On a PC, hold Ctrl and scroll the mouse wheel up or down to make the text larger or smaller. On the results screen, you can choose a report language separately from the questionnaire language. If you flagged an issue, you can open a separate feedback report from the clinician preview and save it as its own PDF.

strings.legalBody:
The questionnaire works offline, uses no analytics and does not send answers automatically. Answers remain in the open questionnaire; save progress to a file to keep them if you need to pause. You can keep the file on your phone or computer. It is not encrypted and may contain private health answers, so share it only with people you trust or healthcare professionals. Do not post it on social media or anywhere public.

The questionnaire deliberately uses calm, gentle language so its questions feel less intimidating and people may find it easier to complete it and seek professional help.

Question feedback is saved in a separate PDF. It does not include your questionnaire answers. Do not include your name or other personal details in comments. This build is for technical professional review; it is not clinically validated and does not diagnose.
strings.backupWarning: If progress has not been saved to a file, closing the browser, taking a call or another interruption may cause it to be lost. Save progress to a file before taking a break.

strings.feedbackLocalOnly: Flags and comments stay in this open questionnaire. They are not delivered to the developer automatically. To share saved feedback, open the feedback report from Results.
strings.feedbackDeliveryPrivacy: This opens a draft in your email app. Your email app/provider may save or transmit the draft; email is not anonymous. Review the feedback and remove sensitive details you typed before sending. Only flagged questions, feedback categories and comments are included, not your questionnaire answers. You must press Send in your email app.
